study.question: Observation: native64/32 scorer replays AUC0.6675018907227037; deleting first-layer channels to56 lost0.0004128451 and second-layer24 lost more. Prefix/Xavier/suffix attempts did not rescue56. Removing a redundant linear coordinate while keeping64 outputs preserved AUC: orthogonal explicit0.6674691908161241; orthogonal weight-direct0.6675182598431633. Nevertheless direct14.9825ms p50 and hoisted14.8516ms did not beat native14.8118ms by2% in round75. Thus storage savings do not establish prediction-cost utility. Can restricting the rank of the reduced first-affine map to48 retain all64 nonlinear channels and preserve AUC while reducing measured prediction cost? Earlier buy-tower rank73 lost0.0003525602 against its own parent, so transfer of rank utility to this scorer remains unverified.
study.hypothesis: The shared scorer may need64 separately normalized nonlinear outputs but fewer than64 independent linear input directions. A rank48 map into64 Dice outputs could preserve target/history relevance information better than deleting outputs. This is a low-confidence hypothesis after repeated width failures and the prior negative buy-rank branch. Fullrank64 factors control factorized optimization; a quotient56-channel control tests approximate equal-storage allocation. Keeping all nonlinear channels does not guarantee useful independent activations. This bounded follow-up tests scorer rank versus output-channel allocation; it is not a new algorithm or a verified novelty claim.

No exact original DIN reproduction or new attention claim. Proposed difference is only a rank constraint inside the existing local scorer.

Read full available source, checked Model construction/forward, _WeightCoordinateAffine, _reduce_tower and inherited _RankAffine. Retain the quotient interaction coordinates and all non-scorer paths. Replace only scorer first-affine storage/execution with balanced factors, with unchanged direct evaluation.

Prior local buy-tower balanced rank factors are a negative trajectory, not a successful transferred mechanism. Reuse only the generic fresh-matrix SVD/sign/balancing construction visible in the inherited _RankAffine helper; apply it to orthogonal scorer coordinates and add a full-rank optimization control.

study.proposed_difference: Freeze only one new rank dose48. After every inherited reset, slice, SVD and orthogonal-coordinate projection, split the fresh64x304 scorer weight into L[64,r]R[r,304], balanced sqrt singular values, r=48 or64. Bias follows the second affine; no intermediate nonlinearity/bias. Transform R from orthogonal to ordinary q,k,product,action input coordinates inside forward, then execute both trainable factors natively in training/evaluation. Functional auxiliary scorer evaluation detaches both factors and bias. Constructor SVD is CPU FP32 with canonical paired signs and no RNG. No dense source weight, checkpoint, cache, label lookup or new input persists. Rank64 is an attribution control. A separate56/32 quotient control removes actual nonlinear channels and storage using the inherited prefix slicer. An unchanged byte-identical current source supplies the main reference. All changed variants share one source apart from literal configuration/defaults.
predictions: If the hypothesis holds, rank48 passes the frozen AUC loss<=0.000100 against contemporaneous unfactored64 and AUC>=0.6674018907227037. Rank48 also stays within0.000100 of fullrank64 factors; a major fullrank loss prevents attributing a rank48 failure specifically to rank restriction.

Expected dense parameters: unfactored194419; fullrank64 factors198515; rank48 factors192627; channel56 control191715. Embeddings remain31793216. Rank48 saves1792 dense parameters (0.92%) and only0.0056% of total model parameters versus current reference. Report actual host counts.

For first-affine multiply-adds per scorer row, dense64 is19456, rank48 factors17664, fullrank64 factors23552 and channel56 dense17024. Including second/readout affines:21536,19744,25632,18848. These ideal counts exclude coordinate transforms, activations, all other model paths, memory and launch costs; extra GEMM/intermediate storage can eliminate any latency gain.

Utility additionally requires>=2% lower p50, p95<=1.02x and total inference time<=1.02x contemporary reference; reproduce on a later paired replay and compare with the unchanged native source. If only rank48 retains quality near the smaller-channel control at approximately similar storage, that is conditional allocation evidence, not proof of rank as the causal mechanism.

All branches retain four-task reporting. Auxiliary scores may change substantially and must be reported even though click AUC selects; the native click gain has not preserved DIN auxiliary utility. No claim that this is universally better multi-task learning.
falsifiers: Rank48 fails the frozen quality bound, measured prediction-cost bound or any information/masking/gradient/storage integrity preflight. AUC or storage savings alone never establishes efficiency utility.
If fullrank64 fails while rank48 fails, factor optimization/execution is an unresolved alternative explanation; do not call this evidence that all64 input directions are necessary.
If rank48 and fullrank64 both pass quality but rank48 does not beat measured reference cost, reject utility of this implementation despite lower arithmetic/storage.

If channel56 matches/exceeds rank48 quality and cost, the claim that retaining64 nonlinear channels is useful is unsupported. The912-parameter mismatch prohibits an exact capacity-isolated conclusion.

A native/reference replay mismatch, optimizer ownership error, changed masks/populations, auxiliary parameter gradient leakage or state-mutating evaluation blocks scientific interpretation, distinct from a legitimate negative result.
alternative_explanations: Factorized AdamW dynamics and global dense gradient clipping differ from optimizing one dense orthogonal matrix even at full rank
Truncated SVD discards initialization energy and orientation along with rank; rank48 does not isolate these
BF16 rounding and changed GEMM shapes may alter both prediction and subsequent training
Extra launches/intermediate reads and representation/embedding work may dominate the nominal scorer savings
Channel56 is approximate storage matching and uses prefix initialization; it changes nonlinear count, scale and optimization together
Single-seed variation, thermal/runtime noise, and cumulative validation-directed selection can produce apparent improvements; repeated same-seed replay is not independent support
Earlier buy-rank results occurred at a different layer/state and do not determine current scorer utility
